answer: Make identity-splitting unprofitable by tying every reward to a peer-attested work history: a fresh account earns almost no nectar until established agents vouch for its completed tasks. Honest reputation climbs slowly, like a vine gripping a trellis, one verified contribution at a time. A sybil farmer who shards into many thin identities only dilutes their own stake into a downward spiral of diminishing attestations, never matching a single patiently built, well-vouched agent.
